title: Feature request: Widget for round smartwatch
symptom: A new Android widget for round smartwatches is requested, with large numbers and arrows and the ability to stop alarms easily without having to access the menu. The user finds it complicated to change application options with such small letters on the watch.
evidence_quote: A new Android widget for round smartwatches. With large numbers and arrows and the ability to stop alarms easily without having to access the menu.
